nextSearch.reason: Repeated negative-before-gas results make threshold or persistence changes unsuitable. The supplied scan has already probed event tokens against WETH and USDG across four fee tiers; continuing this direction collects factory getPool results for untested tokens and may reveal older companion pools outside the recent event window. This addresses the failed-cluster pattern by searching for other assets and pool identities, not by asserting a new strategy.
